# ADR-020: License first-party skills under Apache 2.0

## Status

Accepted, 2026-08-31.

## Context

This fixture preserves a safe legacy numbered suffix outside the stable-slug grammar.

## Decision

Keep the record numeric-only for compatibility.

## Consequences

The allocator still reads its number when deriving the exact base maximum.

## Alternatives considered

Rewriting the historical filename was rejected.
